name: gizza-ai/dedup-within-cell
summary: Remove duplicate items inside delimited CSV cells

tool.description: Remove repeated items inside selected CSV/TSV cells while preserving rows and columns. Paste table text in `data`; each selected cell is split by `item_separator`, deduped, optionally case-folded and sorted, then joined back with the original spacing or `output_separator`. Use `columns` to target header names or 1-based indices, `delimiter` for the table delimiter, and `output=stats` for a removal report.

columns.description: Comma-separated 1-based column numbers or header names to process, e.g. `2,tags`. Leave blank to process every column. Header names require has_header=true.

data.description: CSV/TSV/table text to clean. Each selected cell is treated as a delimited list, e.g. `a, b, a, c` becomes `a, b, c`. A single-column input works too (one list per line). Maximum 1 MB.

delimiter.description: Delimiter between table fields: comma for CSV (default), tab for TSV, semicolon, or pipe. This is not the same as item_separator inside a cell.

drop_empty.description: Drop empty items created by repeated separators, e.g. `a,,b,,,a` -> `a,b`. Enabled by default.

has_header.description: Treat the first row as a header. Header rows are never rewritten, and column names in `columns` are resolved from it.

ignore_case.description: Treat differently-cased items as duplicates while keeping the first occurrence's original casing.

item_separator.description: Separator between items inside each cell. Use comma for `a,b,a`, comma-space for `a, b, a`, semicolon, pipe, space, tab, or newline.

output.description: Return the rewritten table as csv (default), or stats for a plain-text count of rows, cells scanned, cells changed, and duplicate items removed.

output_separator.description: Separator used to join the kept items. Leave blank to preserve the cell's original separator and spacing (for example comma-space stays comma-space).

sort_items.description: Order for the surviving items inside each cell: none keeps first-seen order, asc sorts A-Z, desc sorts Z-A.

trim_items.description: Trim whitespace around each item before comparing and writing it back. Enabled by default.
